# Verb + 過 · *Verb + gwo3*

**Meaning:** have ever done (experience) · **Level:** A2 · **Topic:** Time and aspect

> ⚠️ **Draft — awaiting native-speaker review.** Spotted something unnatural? Please [report it](https://github.com/jyltsang/cantonlink-community/issues/new?template=content-error.yml&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20grammar%2Fgwo3-experience).

過 after a verb says you have had the experience at some point: 'have been to', 'have tried'. 未 + Verb + 過 means 'have never'.

## Examples

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **我去過日本。** |
| Jyutping | ngo5 heoi3 gwo3 jat6 bun2. |
| Yale | ngóh heui gwo yaht bún. |
| Bopomofo | ㆭㄛ⁵ ㄏㆤㄧ³ ㄍㄨㄛ³ ㄧㄜㆵ⁶ ㄅㄨㄣ². |
| English | I've been to Japan. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **你飲過鴛鴦未呀？** |
| Jyutping | nei5 jam2 gwo3 jin1 joeng1 mei6 aa3? |
| Yale | néih yám gwo yīn yēung meih a? |
| Bopomofo | ㄋㄝㄧ⁵ ㄧㄜㆬ² ㄍㄨㄛ³ ㄧㄣ¹ ㄧㆦㄥ¹ ㄇㄝㄧ⁶ ㄚ³? |
| English | Have you ever tried yuenyeung (coffee with milk tea)? |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **我未見過佢。** |
| Jyutping | ngo5 mei6 gin3 gwo3 keoi5. |
| Yale | ngóh meih gin gwo kéuih. |
| Bopomofo | ㆭㄛ⁵ ㄇㄝㄧ⁶ ㄍㄧㄣ³ ㄍㄨㄛ³ ㄎㆤㄧ⁵. |
| English | I've never met him. |
